examples.name: SaaS Starter
examples.description: Auth, notes, and billing modules with dual-source-of-truth caches, an internal coupling violation, and injection-prone SQL. Full 6-phase run: analyzed, planned, refactored across 5 approved stages, and synthesized.

examples.name: Storefront
examples.description: Catalog, inventory, and cart modules with a non-atomic stock decrement duplicated in two places, an N+1 catalog query, and no idempotency on checkout.

examples.name: Patient Records
examples.description: Patient, appointment, and clinical-notes modules with PII logged in plaintext, no field-level access control, and no audit trail on PHI access.
examples.flagshipRisk: PII/PHI exposure and missing audit trail

examples.name: Ledger & Transfers
examples.description: Accounts, transfers, and ledger modules with a non-atomic balance transfer (a classic double-spend), float-typed currency, and no idempotency key on retries.
